summary: Designed scale-out The Nomad Studio coordinator for 100 to 10,000+ workers: GitHub authority plane, PostgreSQL transactional accepted-event ledger and outbox, partitioned durable queue, incrementally projected inboxes/ACKs, fenced source leases, hashed batch archives and hierarchical Director reporting. Committed draft PR #25 with 10 individually owned workgroups and 4 merge waves; reconciled concurrent Studio 1.0.0 cleanup PR #24 exact merge SHA. Documentation/workflow validation only, no infrastructure deployment, source gates, actual chat execution or paid model invocation.
